{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values or implausible data in customer_age
sentinel_values = sales_df['customer_age'].isin([-1, -99, 999, 9999])

# Count how many sentinel values are present
sentinel_count = sentinel_values.sum()

# Check the unique values in customer_age
unique_ages = sales_df['customer_age'].unique()

sentinel_count, unique_ages"}
